description: GeoGuard Kerala is a free web app that helps Kerala families understand and prepare for flood and storm risk. It uses NASA POWER to show 20+ years of rainfall trends (monsoon patterns, heavy-rain days, wet streaks), NASA EONET to show open natural hazard events, and NASA GIBS satellite imagery to show current conditions. An action layer turns the data into simple before, during and after checklists for floods, landslides and cyclones. Built solo for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
